title: anatomy-to-tract mapping infers white matter pathways without diffusion streamline propagation
core_idea: Introduce a framework (anatomy-to-tract mapping, ATM) that generates bundle-specific streamlines directly from high-quality T1-weighted anatomical MRI by learning from paired T1 and tractogram data, avoiding orientation field estimation, voxelwise segmentation, and point-to-point streamline propagation, and enabling synthesis of anatomically plausible, subject-specific white matter streamlines that handle complex configurations (crossing, kissing, bending).
tldr: ATM is a T1-driven ML/DL method to infer bundle-specific white matter streamlines without relying on diffusion-based streamline propagation.
